info.name: GrubDelivery Mobile API
info.description: Postman Collection for testing and integrating the GrubDelivery Mobile vertical APIs. Contains all authentication, account management, dashboard, support, employee management, and restaurant management endpoints.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for the delivery mobile application. These endpoints do not require authentication.

request.description: Log in to the delivery mobile application using either email, phone, or a combination of type and body with a password.
Send a one-time password (OTP) to the specified email or phone number for verification.
Verify the sent OTP to complete authentication.
Resend the verification OTP to the user.
Send an OTP for resetting the password.
Verify the password reset OTP.
Set a new password after verifying the forget-password OTP.
Set the user password directly.
Resend the OTP for resetting password.
Reset the password using email, OTP, and new password directly.
Verify if an account exists under the given identifier.
Log out from the application.
Refresh authentication token.

item.name: Account
item.description: Endpoints relating to user profile, account updates, ownership transfers, and deletion.

request.description: Retrieve the profile details of the currently authenticated user.
Alternative endpoint to retrieve the profile details of the authenticated user.
Update the profile and credentials of the authenticated user.
Resend the OTP for confirming account details updates.
Confirm account details update by verifying the sent OTP.
Transfer ownership of selected or all resources to a new owner.
Verify and complete ownership transfer via OTP.

query.description: Filter by power status: on, off, unknown (optional)

request.description: Retrieve all GrubPac boxes associated with the authenticated user.
Initiate account deletion by verifying password.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Dashboard telemetry and analytical summary metrics.

request.description: Retrieve high-level metrics and statistics for the dashboard view.

item.name: Support
item.description: Customer support categories and FAQ articles.

request.description: Get categories of support tickets or FAQs.
Retrieve FAQ questions and answers.

item.name: Employee
item.description: Management of drivers and managers associated with the delivery vertical.

request.description: Register a new employee with the role 'manager' or 'delivery'.

query.description: Filter by status: active, unassigned, suspended (optional)

request.description: Retrieve list of employees under the client's account.
Retrieve dropdown items such as roles or status filters.
Suspend one or multiple employee accounts by their ULIDs.
Reactivate one or multiple suspended employee accounts.
Hard delete one or multiple employee records.

item.name: Restaurant
item.description: Restaurant locations management and resource assignments.

request.description: Create a new restaurant location.
Retrieve list of all restaurants.
Unassign resources (drivers/boxes) from a restaurant.
Suspend resources assigned to a restaurant.
Get detailed information about a single restaurant location.
Modify details of an existing restaurant location.
Get global app configuration parameters for the delivery mobile vertical.

item.name: Boxes
item.description: Endpoints for managing boxes, connection, settings, and lock controls.

request.description: List all boxes assigned to the driver.
Register a new box to the driver.
Get details for a specific box.
Remove a box assignment.
Update settings for a box.
Establish a connection with a box.
Disconnect from a box.
Request an OTP to lock/unlock the box.
Verify lock OTP.
Instantly lock a box without requiring an OTP.

item.name: Notification
item.description: Endpoints for managing push notifications and alerts.

request.description: List and filter notifications.
Mark notifications as read or dismissed.
Generate a fake notification for testing.
